task: Given the image of the product being viewed, return Top-5 OTHER products with similar characteristics. Not personalised recommendation, not purchase prediction.

research_questions.RQ1: Do ResNet-50 (ImageNet) embeddings produce Top-5 lists of other products that humans judge as similar?
research_questions.RQ2: How does the quality of visual similarity differ from a metadata-similarity baseline?

data.articles_csv_encoding: utf-8-sig, all id columns read as str
data.catalog_scope: the 500 articles of the website catalog; no product is generated or added

product_unit.rationale: Articles sharing product_code are colour/print variants of the same design (detail_desc identical within all 145 codes). Showing them as 'other products' would be trivial and would duplicate items; 108 catalog rows duplicate an existing (product_code, colour_group_code) pair and 2 articles have byte-identical images.
product_unit.representative_rule: article with the smallest sha256('42:rep:'+article_id) hex among valid catalog articles of the product_code (deterministic pseudo-random; revised from 'lowest article_id' before freezing because that rule over-selected Black variants: 84/145)
product_unit.image_validity: file exists, decodes with PIL verify() and convert('RGB'), min side >= 300 px, sha256 equals the website public copy

candidate_pool.definition: all representative products (one per product_code) except the query product itself

query_sampling.allocation: 5 per stratum, the remaining queries split proportionally to stratum size (largest remainder, ties broken by stratum name)
query_sampling.within_stratum: random.Random(42) sample over representatives sorted by article_id; strata processed in sorted name order

pilot.pool: representatives not selected as evaluation queries
pilot.use: annotator training and guide clarification only; pilot labels never enter results

V-R50-FULLPAD.note: NEW configuration. NOT B2-v1: no mask, no bbox crop (H&M has no masks); full packshot, aspect-preserving resize + padding.
V-R50-FULLPAD.weights: ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V2 (cached file resnet50-11ad3fa6.pth, same weights as weeks 4-6)
V-R50-FULLPAD.head: fc replaced by torch.nn.Identity; output of global average pool
preprocessing: PIL open, convert('RGB'), EXIF orientation not applied (H&M files carry none; verify in run)
resize so the LONGER side = 224, aspect ratio kept, PIL BICUBIC
pad to 224x224, image centred; fill = mean RGB (rounded int) of the outer 2% border strips of the resized image
V-R50-FULLPAD.similarity: cosine = dot product of L2-normalised float32 vectors
V-R50-FULLPAD.ranking: sort by score descending; exact float32 value compared
V-R50-FULLPAD.query_exclusion: query product removed from the candidate list before ranking
V-R50-FULLPAD.cache: embeddings saved once to week7/outputs/hm/embeddings (not yet created); re-run must reproduce bit-identical top-5

M-ATTR-TFIDF.note: Metadata baseline, no CNN, only real columns of articles.csv (representative article row).
M-ATTR-TFIDF.score: S(q,c) = sum_f w_f * 1[value_f(q) == value_f(c) and neither missing] + w_desc * cos_tfidf(detail_desc_q, detail_desc_c)
M-ATTR-TFIDF.weights_origin: fixed a priori from the attribute hierarchy (type > colour > pattern > audience); set before any ranking or human label exists; never tuned
M-ATTR-TFIDF.missing: value missing if empty string, '-1', or name in {Unknown, Undefined}; a missing value on either side contributes 0; weights are NOT renormalised; empty detail_desc gives cosine 0
M-ATTR-TFIDF.tfidf: lowercase, tokens = regex [a-z0-9]+, no stop list, tf = 1+ln(count), idf = ln((1+N)/(1+df))+1 with N = number of representatives, L2-normalised vectors; fitted on detail_desc of the candidate universe only (no labels)
M-ATTR-TFIDF.excluded_fields: prod_name (brand-style names, not attributes), department/section (organisational), article_id/product_code (identity)
M-ATTR-TFIDF.score_rounding: round(S, 9) before sorting to remove floating-point order artefacts
